Destructive pattern detected: git clean (force)
Full command: git clean --force
This command is permanently blocked. Safe route: preview what would be removed first with 'git clean -n' (dry-run — lists targets, deletes nothing), or use 'git clean -i' for an interactive prompt per file/directory. Both are already permitted by this hook; only the force forms (-f/--force) are blocked.
